cohort: 20 exposed development hunks; 171 reference lines; not final held-out test

consensus.rule: at least 3 valid model votes; unique plurality with at least 2 votes; 2-2 tie resolved by frozen priority; all-different votes abstain
consensus.priority_basis: prior exposed development wrapper-normalized accuracy; no new run scores used

consensus_latency_note: Sequential ensemble requires the sum of four model times; consensus seconds=0 means combination itself is not timed, not free inference
differences_from_old_v6: Whole-document JSON/list transport parsing; deterministic controls; eager attention instead of SDPA. Prompt semantics and model revisions unchanged.
